extracted.name: Tomato, Corn, and Avocado Salsa
extracted.description: Fresh tomatoes, corn, and avocado combine in this colorful salsa recipe, which is seasoned with lime juice and onions. Serve with your favorite chips.
ingredient_lines: 1 (11 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (4 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained
1 red bell pepper, seeded and diced
instruction_lines: Mix together corn, olives, tomatoes, onion, red pepper, and jalapeño pepper in a large bowl until well combined. Gently fold in avocados, olive oil, lime juice, and salt.
